end.summary:
Practised sorting objects that roll, slide, or stack by looking at their surfaces.
Anika identified curved-surface examples such as a laddoo and a drum.
They identified flat objects such as a book and matchbox as sliding rather than rolling.
The idea that only balls can roll remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using the shape of an object’s surface to predict whether it will roll or slide. Anika explained several examples and noticed that a drum or laddoo can roll, but they still mixed up the idea that only balls roll; this was not corrected after the last example. At home, try rolling a ball, bottle, can, and box, then ask which curved part helps each object move.
